entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So this room's for the wrong answer...[n]What woulda happened to us if we[n]chose it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I guess we may as well check.

entries.speaker: Shadow in a Lab Coat
entries.en: Maybe I just need a break. I've been[n]helping patients with no end in sight.[n]This is no good for me...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A Shadow... It's rather easy to imagine[n]now what would've happened had we[n]chosen A instead.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like we were right—choosing the[n]answer that Maruki would believe is[n]correct is the safest way for us to advance.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's just sneak away... It'd be a pain[n]if we had to deal with that.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We don't know what's happening[n]in there. We should investigate the[n]reception area thoroughly first.
